correctness.rationale: Logistic comparison gives x(t)<=2(r+sh)/a=L eventually. The renewal birth flux is bounded by KxP, mortality between m=mu_M exp(-rho L)>0 and M=gL+||mu_B||inf+mu_M, so P'<=KLP. On every full maturation interval all age-t−T survivors are adults at t, and survival>=e^(-MT), hence y2(t)>=e^(-MT)P(t−T)>=exp[-(M+KL)T]P(t)=cP(t). Choosing q=bc/(2K) and V=x+qP cancels half the xP growth and gives V'<=(C+m)L-mV for t after t0+T. Comparison supplies exact stated absorbing bound; local continuation follows prey logistic and finite-time Gronwall P bound with renewal flux controlled. Uniform global background-mortality bound is essential and explicitly assumed. Independently tested 30,000 admissible parameter/point configurations for coercive mixed-term algebra and bounds. Neither prior numerical plots nor these finite tests are a universal PDE proof; the characteristic inequality is.
